# 10-safety-case

The safety case, the technical documentation index, the cybersecurity case, the assessment reports, the release record and declaration draft, the AI Act record; gate and confirmation records.

Standard clauses: UL 4600, IEC 61508-1 §8, Machinery Regulation Art. 21 and Annexes IV–V, AI Act Art. 6 and 43, IEC 62443-4-1 §4.3.
